row_alignment: row_index 0..chunks-1 and chunk_id match across chunks.jsonl, chunks.csv, embeddings.npy, and embeddings.csv

files.chunks.jsonl: Canonical UTF-8 chunk records, one JSON object per line
files.chunks.csv: Readable UTF-8 CSV copy of all chunks, including full text
files.embeddings.npy: Canonical float32 matrix for fast retrieval
files.embeddings.csv: Readable CSV copy; row_index and chunk_id precede dimensions
files.manifest.md: Human-readable index metadata and handoff instructions
